name: io.github.toasternet/delegaize-agenten-check
title: DelegAIze Agent Check
description: Agent check without sign-in: which AI agents would take over your recurring office work.

tools.name: agenten_check
tools.description: Returns the DelegAIze agent catalogue (what each agent does, its tools, minutes saved per item), the clustering rules, the agents that match the input by keyword, and a personal link (demo or free start) carrying utm and ref/pc. Input: EITHER beschreibung (the user's description of their work or one pasted mail) OR mail_uebersicht (subjects + sender domains, optionally a count per line, that YOUR mail tools collected — no bodies, no full addresses). No sign-in, nothing is stored, no data leaves for third parties. You do the reasoning: cluster with the rules, then present processes, agents and the estimated hours per month.

beschreibung.description: Description of the work or one pasted mail (max 8000 chars).

mail_uebersicht.description: One entry per mail or per group of similar mails.

tage.description: How many days the mail summary covers (for the per-month estimate). Default 30.

variante.description: Campaign entry: backoffice (default), sap, maschinenbau, partner, verain (clubs), coachaize (studios), tekta (structures). sachverstaendige returns the trial case file link instead.

ref.description: Optional person code from the link the user came with (e.g. th, km). Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.

pc.description: Optional partner code from the user's link. Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.

tools.name: agenten_check_mail
tools.description: Returns a link to the DelegAIze page where the user connects Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP READ-ONLY. There the last 100 mails are clustered into recurring processes, 1-3 agents run live on them as drafts, and access is revoked or discarded right after. Use it when the user wants the check on their real mailbox but you have no mail tools, or prefers us to do the analysis. Explain that they must give consent on the page. Nothing happens until they open the link.

variante.description: Campaign entry: backoffice (default), sap, maschinenbau, partner, verain (clubs), coachaize (studios), tekta (structures). sachverstaendige returns the trial case file link instead.

pc.description: Optional partner code from the user's link. Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.
